steps_overwatch2-to-valorant-sensitivity: Input your OW2 sensitivity and FOV. OW2's faster movement and diverse hero abilities create a different aiming context than Valorant.
The Valorant sensitivity is calculated with FOV compensation. Expect it to feel slower due to Valorant's more tactical, angle-holding gameplay.
Apply in Valorant. The adjustment period may take several days — Valorant rewards precise crosshair placement more than OW2's tracking-heavy aim.
